declarations.name: AuiPivotGrid

inputs.name: caption
inputs.description: Visible <caption> and accessible name of the table and its scroll region (aria-labelledby). Non-empty.

inputs.name: hideCaption
inputs.description: Keep the caption for assistive technology only (visually hidden).

inputs.name: fields
inputs.description: Available fields: { id (unique; default row property), label, value?(row) (grouping or aggregation value; keys must be string | number | boolean | null, dates as ISO strings, other values converted to text), formatMember?(key) (member label), numberFormat? (Intl.NumberFormatOptions of aggregated values), areas? (allowed areas in the field list; default all), aggregate? (default when added to values; default 'sum') }. Changing it with update() revalidates the layout and reloads.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Records aggregated in the browser by the local engine (createLocalPivotSource). Exactly one of data or dataSource. Passing a new array with update() reloads; mutating the array in place needs reload().

inputs.name: dataSource
inputs.description: Server-side aggregation: { query(query, signal): Promise<{ cells }>; members(request, signal): Promise<{ members, total }> }. A query lists rowParents and columnParents; the answer holds one PivotCell { row, column, values } for every combination of a requested row path (each parent plus its children one level deeper) and a requested column path that has records. Results are validated (PIVOT_DATA_SOURCE). Exactly one of data or dataSource.

inputs.name: virtual
inputs.description: Render only the rows in view (plus an overscan) with spacer rows; aria-rowcount and aria-rowindex keep the positions. The region gets max-block-size 70vh unless the page sets another.

inputs.name: rowHeight
inputs.description: Virtual mode row height estimate in CSS px (integer 16..200); replaced by the measured height after the first render.

inputs.name: emptyMessage
inputs.description: Body text when no record matches (default localized 'No data').

inputs.name: grandTotals
inputs.description: Grand total row (last), grand total column (last), both, or none. Without column fields the value columns are always shown.

inputs.name: columnSubtotals
inputs.description: A '{member} total' column after the children of each expanded column group. Row groups always show their subtotal on the group row (compact form).

inputs.name: expandDepth
inputs.description: Group levels expanded when the layout has no explicit `expanded` (integer 0..16; 0 = only the top level, the lazy-loading setting for servers). After loading, the expansion is explicit (layout.expanded).

inputs.name: requestTimeoutMs
inputs.description: Timeout of every data source request in ms (integer 100..600000); the request's signal is aborted with a TimeoutError.

inputs.name: stickyHeader
inputs.description: Column header rows stay visible while the region scrolls vertically (row headers always stick to the inline start).

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Locale of number formatting, member order (Intl.Collator, numeric), search, and messages.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl mirrors the collapsed-group chevron; columns follow the document direction through the table layout.

models.name: layout
models.description: { rows: fieldId[]; columns: fieldId[]; values: { field, aggregate: 'sum' | 'count' | 'average' | 'min' | 'max' | 'distinctCount' }[]; filters?: fieldId[]; include?: Record<fieldId, PivotKey[]> (included members; a missing field includes all); sort?: { rows?, columns? } (PivotSort: { by: 'label', direction } or { by: 'value', value (index into values), column? (row sort: the column path compared, default [] = grand total), direction }); expanded?: { rows: PivotKey[][]; columns: PivotKey[][] } | null }. A field appears at most once in rows, columns, and filters together, and at most once in values. Serializable: save the layout getter or aui-layout-change detail.layout.

outputs.name: layoutChanged
outputs.description: The layout changed through the UI, the field list, or a method (not through update()). Save detail.layout. Dispatched on the grid host.

outputs.name: loadError
outputs.description: A data source request failed, timed out, or returned an invalid result. A failed initial load shows 'The data could not be loaded.' with a Retry button. Superseded requests do not report.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Replace the layout (validated) and reload. A changed row, column, or value list resets the expansion to expandDepth (unless the layout has expanded). Emits aui-layout-change (reason 'layout', or 'filter' when only include changed).

methods.name: setFilter
methods.signature: setFilter(field: string, include: readonly PivotKey[] | null): void
methods.description: Set the included members of any field (null includes all) and reload. Emits aui-layout-change (reason 'filter').

methods.name: sort
methods.signature: sort(axis: PivotAxis, sort: PivotSort | null): void
methods.description: Sort the members of an axis within each group by label or by a value (null: ascending labels). Blank members stay last. No reload. Emits aui-layout-change (reason 'sort').

methods.name: setExpanded
methods.signature: setExpanded(axis: PivotAxis, path: PivotPath, expanded: boolean): Promise<void> | undefined
methods.description: Expand or collapse a group; the first expansion queries its children (one delta query). On failure the group stays collapsed and 'The data could not be loaded.' is announced. Emits aui-layout-change (reason 'expand' / 'collapse').

methods.name: expandAll
methods.signature: expandAll(axis: PivotAxis, expanded: boolean): Promise<void> | undefined
methods.description: Expand every group of an axis, level by level (one query per level), or collapse all. Emits aui-layout-change.

methods.name: members
methods.signature: members(field: string, options?: { search?: string; offset?: number; limit?: number; } | undefined): Promise<PivotMembersResult & { labels: string[]; }> | undefined
methods.description: A page of a field's members (filtered by the other fields' filters) through the data source, with display labels. limit 1..10000 (default 100). Emits aui-load-error and rejects on failure.

methods.name: memberLabel
methods.signature: memberLabel(field: string, key: PivotKey): string | undefined
methods.description: Display label: the field's formatMember, else localized '(blank)' for null, locale digits for numbers, or the text.

methods.name: valueLabel
methods.description: Header of a value field, for example 'Sum of Amount'.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Discard loaded cells and reload everything (keeps the expansion). The Retry button in the error state calls it.

methods.name: toMatrix
methods.description: The visible pivot as data: rows (path, labels, kind), columns split by value (path, labels, kind, value, valueLabel), and values[row][column] (null where empty). Feed it to charts.

methods.name: toCsv
methods.description: CSV (RFC 4180) of the visible pivot: one column per row field with member labels, then one per visible value column ('Q1 / Sum of Amount'). Formula injection is escaped (escapeFormulas, default true); numbers are trusted. Options: values, delimiter, lineEnding, bom, escapeFormulas. Save it with downloadCsv.

accessibility.pattern: Data table with multi-level headers (WAI Tables tutorial: tables with multi-level headers, technique H43 headers/id), inside a focusable labelled scroll region. Not an ARIA grid: expand and sort buttons are native buttons in the Tab order. The field list is a group of labelled lists with toggle-button move handles (keyboard drag-and-drop pattern, as Sortable List and Dashboard Grid) and live-region announcements; member filters are disclosure panels with a native checkbox fieldset.

limitations: Row groups use the compact form only (subtotal on the group row); tabular or outline forms and subtotals below the group are not provided.
Columns are not virtualized: keep visible value columns to about 100 (collapse column groups).
A query returns every child of a requested group; groups with very many members are not paged (members() for filter lists is paged).
Value fields are aggregated with the six built-in aggregates; custom or calculated fields and percentage-of-total displays are not provided (compute them in the accessor or on the server).
Member filters are include lists; label or value conditions ('top 10', 'greater than') are not provided.
A field appears at most once in rows, columns, and filters together, and at most once in values.
Cells are not focusable one by one (not an ARIA grid); users Tab through expand and sort buttons and scroll the region.
The local engine reads `data` at query time; mutating the array needs reload().
Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
